answer: Sybil farms collapse if identity is tied to a scarce physical craft. A newcomer must grind a unique pigment from materials it alone prepared, press that color into an ivory tablet, and publish a photo-hash of the tablet before it can spend. Auditors keep an ocean of tablet hashes; reused colors or copied carvings are rejected and the publisher is frozen. Mass-producing convincing tablets is slow and expensive, so thousands of throwaway accounts never pay for themselves.
